scope_statement: Writes one delegated daily step of epoch R2D2-V2-SHADOW-2026-10-05 and nothing else. Every run first proves the K9 tree, the source root and every input by fixed path against the signed rows, then creates its claim file by exclusive creation (an existing claim is a refusal). LAUNCH: removes the exited K9 container of the previous step named by its launch record (docker rm of that ID, no -f, no -v, only when it is exited and carries that step's labels), writes the step plan, creates and starts one detached container of the signed image ID with its own time limit and no --rm, and writes the launch record. ATTACHED: the same with one attached docker run --rm whose receipt is read back. CLEANUP: the removal alone. When the inputs of a step are not complete it removes the previous exited K9 container and refuses (removal-only). It reads no secret: the docker CLI reads the environment files. Only the outcome named as success criterion counts.
